_comment: Founder-approved decision rule (2026-11-06): thresholds are DECISIONS written in advance, not forecasts. 'Not measured' is never counted as a miss: a checkpoint with unmeasured clicks reports UNKNOWN and asks for the measurement to be fixed. Pins started publishing 2026-11-06.

checkpoints.if_missed: Pins reach nobody or point at the wrong products: review the pin text and images, concentrate the pins on the 5 strongest tools for one buyer, check that clicks are measured at all.
Traffic or conversion is not there: change positioning or price of the top tools (one change at a time, recorded), and put the founder-gated service path (Umrah-agency demo outreach) first.
Founder decision: stop adding tools, keep only the channels that produced a measured click, and move the effort to the service arm.
